Independent scope review by prospective_guard_scope_review (lean_expert), inspected exact26b657340225c276ed7c7069d28fbdb8d400f74a and current prospective protocol; no builds, tests or study payload reads. Conclusion: integrated E1 working-launch checker is blocked on a concrete study contract, rather than numerical placeholders alone.
The protocol leaves population/actual reader, uncertain-gold/reference construction, independent units, executable arms/scorer/uncertainty/stopping and coding/opening authority unfrozen. sealed_split.require_readable:164-201 records a committed-manifest read but does not interpret scientific approval or require an unopened ledger; repeated reads after committing the ledger are intentional existing semantics. Memento's concrete read_units:131 is corpus-specific. scored_capture._read:121-156 is development-only; historical_capture.load_plan:114 fixes retrospective Sherlock and two historical arms. study_exposure.verify_exposure:121 binds bytes/revisions but explicitly does not establish rights, consent or sealed-test permission. No inspected approved prospective reader/scorer contract was found. Reusing those routes without a new selected contract would change scope/authority.
Minimum decision package: selected experiment/corpus and payload-reader entrypoint; participant/session/source-family equivalences and exposure metadata; executable arms and scoring/uncertainty policies; independently recorded authority freezing those bytes and authorizing coding/opening. Numeric thresholds may remain unset during development but are mandatory before freeze/launch. U1 is a prerequisite only if that admission route is chosen.
After that contract exists, implement a dedicated prospective module and courts integrated into the selected reader's sole prospective entrypoint, reusing committed-byte checks and durable ledger machinery. Important prospective acceptance: expected-unopened check and opening record occur under the same ledger lock. Test competing opening between preflight/authorization, refusal before first payload open for changed scorer/instrument/threshold/allocation/authority, and durable accounting after failure, with named compiling mutations. This is a design constraint for the future E1 integration, not an occurrence finding or current-reader defect. An injected dummy callback alone does not prove that integration. A separately approved contract not inspected here could change the verdict.
Existing owner corpus/coder/resource and scientific contract choices remain pending. No new read, frozen status, implementation acceptance or external action is authorized by this review. E1/E2/E3 remain open.
